traits.note: Wikipedia, Lepidocaryum (read 2026-10-14): small reduplicate leaves, palmate, on petioles about 60 cm; dioecious. Mabberley (2017) places it in subfamily I, subtribe Mauritiinae.

traits.clonal.note: Dransfield et al. (Genera Palmarum, 2nd ed., 2008), under the genus: it grows in clusters of stems.
